method.limits: SRTM models the surface including buildings and trees at 30 m. It describes how steep the ground is, not whether it will fail.
method.normalisation: min(1, slope / full_scale_deg); an engineering assumption, not fitted
method.sample_spacing: 1 arc-second, about 31 m north-south and 28 m east-west here
method.slope: Horn (1981) 3x3 finite differences at each elevation sample
method.statistic: 90th percentile (nearest rank) of sample slopes within the buffer

source.name: SRTM 1 arc-second global elevation, tile N25E091
source.packaged_by: Tilezen terrain tiles (skadi) on AWS Open Data
source.provider: NASA / USGS Shuttle Radar Topography Mission
